items.html: And just as the Holy One, blessed be He, sits and roars over his mate who was banished from him, so too the Nukva cries and screams and roars to her husband — he is within, in Atzilut, and she is outside, in Beria. And this is the secret of 'O God, be not silent to You, God, be not still and be not quiet, etc.,' expounded in the Zohar, portion Lech Lecha, as above, concerning the Shekhina, which is called Elohim and is called El, for El is similar to her; and 'be not silent, and be not quiet' — with the voice of her cry, may her Beloved raise her from the pit of ruin to her first place, with him, in the world of Atzilut.
